publicComments.name: Maria Stockton
publicComments.summary: Introduced herself as the new CSEA Chapter President and reported that negotiations with the district had begun productively over the past two days, thanking her team and district representatives.

publicComments.name: Diana Escalante Ocon
publicComments.summary: A librarian at Adelante Selby for 14 years, she urged the board to reconsider proposed reductions to library staff hours, explaining in detail that every minute of her 7.5-hour day is filled with essential tasks beyond checking out books.

publicComments.name: Devin Mullaney
publicComments.summary: An 8th grade teacher at Hoover expressed appreciation for the administration and support staff, specifically praised the librarians Diana and Nancy Valles, and asked the board to support them.

publicComments.name: Megan O'Reilly Green
publicComments.summary: A parent with four children in the Orion Mandarin Immersion Program called to express support for both MI and Co-op TK class placements at Orion, and asked the district to present accurate growth data to the community for collaborative decision-making.

items.title: Bond Program Consent Items
Bond Program Action Items — Approval of Agreement for Rental and Purchase of Mobile Air Conditioning Units

publicComments.name: Carl Anders
publicComments.summary: Expressed support for HVAC upgrades and portable AC but urged the board not to use bond funds for short-term rentals, since every bond dollar costs taxpayers approximately $3.40 over 30 years, suggesting rentals be paid from the general fund and only purchases charged to the bond.

publicComments.name: Devin Mullaney
publicComments.summary: Expressed relief at the air conditioning approval but raised a concern about floor-mounted portable units taking up space in already crowded classrooms, suggesting roof-mounted permanent units would be preferable.

School/Community Reports — Information on Financial Audit Report for RCSD for 2023-24 School Year
School/Community Reports — Hoover and Roy Cloud School Presentations for the 2024-2025 School Year

publicComments.name: Larry Broussard
publicComments.summary: A long-time volunteer and staff member at Hoover praised the entire Hoover team, commended the principal and assistant principals by name, and raised a safety concern about the need for better traffic cones and signage at the school crosswalk.

publicComments.name: Laura Lentz
publicComments.summary: A teacher at Hoover described it as the most challenging job of her career and expressed deep appreciation for the administrative team and her fellow teachers for their dedication and collaborative spirit.

publicComments.name: Lizbeth Estrada
publicComments.summary: A Hoover parent (speaking in Spanish, with interpretation provided) praised the teachers' collaboration and emotional support for students, emphasized the importance of the family-school community relationship, and called for quality education, values, and safety at the school.
